info.description:
Public REST API for Benchmark Email.

Authenticate every request by including your API key in the `X-API-Key` header.
Each key is issued with one or more scopes that control which endpoints it may call.

Rate limits: 60 requests per minute per account.
Monthly quota: determined by your subscription plan.

put.description: Delta mutation for one existing contact. Accepts any combination of `addTags`, `removeTags`, `addLists`, `removeLists`, and `updateFields`; omitted operations leave the corresponding facet unchanged. Status changes are handled by `PATCH /api/contact/:contactId`, not this endpoint. Operations are atomic — all-or-nothing in a single save. Idempotent: adding a tag already present, removing a tag not present, or setting a field to its current value is a no-op and is rejected with 400 only when *every* operation in the request resolves to no change. `__v` is optional: when supplied, optimistic-concurrency control is enforced (stale version → 400 ConcurrencyError); when omitted, the request runs last-write-wins.

400.description: Validation error, no-op rejection, or concurrency conflict (stale __v)

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer token or API key

403.description: API key lacks the contacts:write scope

404.description: Contact not found in caller's account

put.summary: Apply a delta mutation to a contact.

editorType.description: Which editor produced the campaign body. Campaigns created before the editor choice existed read back as 'unlayer'.

hostedUrl.description: Public URL of the campaign's hosted copy. Always present; null unless the campaign sent successfully and its hosted artifact was stored.

previewImageUrl.description: URL of the last thumbnail that finished rendering. The thumbnail is rendered after the response is sent, so this value may lag a content-changing write and is absent on a freshly created campaign.

scheduledAt.description: Date and time of scheduled email

subStatus.description: Granular failure/cancellation reason. Null for non-failure states or legacy campaigns.

totalRecipients.description: Contacts this campaign is expected to email. 0 until the campaign is scheduled (except for an explicit contact-list audience, counted at creation), then estimated from the audience; narrows to the mailable (active) population when the send begins — the figure the sending-allowance decision uses.
